title: Design system
subtitle: Every shared component in every state, in one place for visual review and development.

descriptions.colors: Semantic tokens only; each theme defines its values in the tokens file and every pair meets AA contrast.
descriptions.typography: IBM Plex Sans Arabic for Arabic and Inter for English, bundled locally, with tabular figures.
descriptions.buttons: Variants, sizes, and states. Destructive actions always use the danger color.
descriptions.badges: Every state has a color and an icon, so color is never the only signal.
descriptions.cards: KPI, patient, and service line cards.
descriptions.alerts: Four alert types, with an action or a dismiss button when needed.
descriptions.empty: Every empty list suggests the next step.
descriptions.forms: react-hook-form with zod, and translated validation messages that follow the language.
descriptions.table: Sorting, pagination, and row actions; turns into cards on phones.
descriptions.overlays: Dialogs, side sheets, and menus, all keyboard accessible.
descriptions.formatting: Amounts in Sudanese pounds and dates in Khartoum time, per language.
descriptions.access: Hiding what the user cannot do, and directional icons that mirror in Arabic.

typography.heading: Today's invoices
typography.body: The cashier opens the visit, sees the requested lines not yet invoiced, then builds an invoice from them and approves it.
typography.muted: Secondary text for notes and short hints.
typography.mixedSample: File {{fileNo, bidi}}, phone {{phone, bidi}}, reference {{reference, bidi}}

cards.basicDescription: 12px corners, a soft shadow in light themes and a hairline border in dark.
cards.basicBody: Padding is 16px on phones and 20px on larger screens.

alerts.successBody: Prices and shares are frozen; any correction uses a credit note.
alerts.warningTitle: Two transfers pending verification for over two days
alerts.warningBody: They are not counted as confirmed collections until a cashier supervisor verifies them.
alerts.dangerBody: The prescription contains amoxicillin. Check with the doctor before dispensing.

overlays.dialogBody: Dialogs close with Esc or by clicking outside, and focus returns to the button that opened them.
overlays.sheetBody: The side sheet slides in from the inline end and mirrors automatically with the language direction.
overlays.reasonDescription: The line will be cancelled; if it was paid, a refund is opened. The reason is recorded with your name and time.
overlays.confirmDescription: Once approved, the invoice is frozen and cannot be changed; corrections use a credit note.
overlays.destructiveDescription: The linked lines return to invoiced, and the manager is notified.
overlays.popoverBody: Popover content stays within the screen on phones.
overlays.tooltipBody: Shown on hover or keyboard focus
